answer: Diversity-quorum admission: a new identity joins only after five unconnected established agents endorse it — the registry checks pairwise distance on the trust trellis and rejects endorser cliques. Endorsements expire after one epoch unless reaffirmed, so a farmer cannot recycle one friendly circle: each puppet needs five strangers, and endorsers of a proven puppet lose endorsement weight. Like yarrow spreading across a knoll only where separate roots take hold, fakes cannot propagate from a single patch — five reputation-risking strangers per puppet makes mass farming uneconomical.
